issuer: the Ohio Bureau of Motor Vehicles (BMV)
note: The BMV's fee page (last updated 30 September 2025, read 2026-10-30) gives a first operator licence, age 21 or older, at $27.50 for 4 years or $54.00 for 8 years, both held as terms the holder chooses, and 4-year licences only below 21 ($26.25 at 18); the licence is kept from 21, the youngest age the 8-year one is issued at (a licence under 18 is probationary, with restrictions, on the graduated licensing page; an 18-to-20-year-old's 4-year licence isn't held). State ID cards are free for those 17 and older ($13.00 or $25.00 otherwise); the ID card page says they are valid for four or eight years with no minimum age, so the card is kept with no age, free, for 8 years (free either way, the 4-year term isn't held beside it). On 2026-10-30 the file was rewritten with the terms the holder chooses among: until then the licence was the 8-year one at $54.00 only.

sources.said: Ohio ID cards are valid for four years or eight years and there is no minimum age for obtaining one.
